tei:div.tei:p: 313)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen padma he ru ka'i don bskang yid bzhin sprin phung bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye:

dbang chen yab yum sgrub pa mchog: nyams su len pa'i skal ldan gyis: tshogs mchod zab mor brtson pa'i thabs: don bzang yid bzhin sprin phung bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: 'byor tshogs phyi nang gsang mchod rnams: ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs spel bsgyur: thod rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs snyan bcas: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong gsum bhandha yangs pa'i nang: gang snang ye shes mchod pa'i sprin: rigs lnga yab yum byin rlabs rdzas: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: chos kun mchod pa'i sprin chen po: rab 'byams zhing kun yongs khyab gyur: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan bdun gyis brlabs: de nas bskang ba dngos ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: rang gsal 'dzin med dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i= kun khyab thugs rjes 'gro 'dul zhing khams nas: gang zag snyan brgyud= snying dbus mi 'gyur thig le'i 314) gzhal yas nas: rigs 'dus las 'brel rtsal gyi= spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng nas: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i= dkyil 'khor yongs la dbang sgyur drag po'i sku: padma he ru ka yi= stong nyid mnyam sbyor shes rab pha rol phyin: sbyor yum rdo rje phag mo'i= ye shes lnga yi rang gzugs phyag rgya'i gar: rigs lnga'i hya grī wa'i= phyogs bcu'i bdud 'dul khro bo khra thabs 'gyed: khro bcu za gsod 'khor bcas= tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren: sgo skyong yab yum lha tshogs= zab gter gnyer 'dzin bka' bzhin phrin las bsgrubaḥ dam can gter bdag rnams kyi= thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i: phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang: ro mngar srab 'jam reg bya'i rigs:

nang mchod rnams kyis= rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dang: snod bcud dbyings bsdus gtor chen po: 'khor ba yongs bsgral rakta dmar: gsang ba'i mchod pas= dmar chen khrag gis arghaṃ sha ra ra: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog hrugs se hrug: sha 315)chen gsur gyi dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs: zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: sha rus zhal zas thod rnga mi rkang gling: rol mo sna tshogs mthun rdzas spyan gzigs sogasaḥ drag po'i thugs mthun rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur pas: rdo rje slob dpon drug dang mched bzhi sku: sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi dang sku gsung thugs: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kun: bskang ngo bshags so tshangs par mdzad du gsol: khyad par med gcig phyal pa lhun grub kyi: dgongs don ma rtogs log 'khrul gang mchis paḥ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces dang yi ge brgya pa brjod: de yis nyams chag sor chud nas: rim gnyis 'bras bu mngon gyur te: tshe 'dir yang dag lam mchog brnyesaḥ the tshom med do sa ma ya: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs zhig brda thim rgya: : ces pa 'di yang mkhan po 316) nor bu dbang rgyal dang shī la badzra gnyis kyis dus ring mo nas yang yang bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// maṅga lam//
